review: No chorus field. Parallels book3/44; the main print splits its four two-half-phrase lines per stanza into eight single lines, so 1:1-1:8 and 2:1-2:8 reuse the twin's settled renderings verbatim (וִיצֻרִי for الكيان, יְשָׁעָה/רְצוֹן Register). Stanza 3 differs in the Arabic: سأسهر is first-person ('I will keep vigil') → רִבּוֹנִי, אֶשְׁקֹד (שָׁקַד per glossary), not the twin's 'help me to watch'; بدف وبعود → בְּתֹף וּבְכִנּוֹר (biblical instruments); زادت أشواقنا → רַבּוּ כִּסּוּפֵינוּ (כִּסּוּפִים preferred to תַּאֲוָה per glossary); تاقت قلوبنا → לִבּוֹתֵינוּ נִכְסְפוּ (plural kept).
